common.riskScorePending: Complete all domain ratings to calculate the composite score and overall risk level.
common.documentsDeliverable: Consent forms and supporting files on record
common.riskGuideTitle: How case risk level is assigned
common.riskGuideIntro: Rate each domain above as Low, Medium, or High. The system averages those ratings to produce a composite score and an overall case risk level.
common.riskGuideRule3: High if average ≥ 2.5 · Medium if average ≥ 1.5 · otherwise Low
common.riskGuideNote: The optional override note is for documentation only; it does not change the calculated risk level.

reportBuilder.lead: Customize reports from the Reports page, or build new tabular and chart views from the data model.
reportBuilder.stepSourceHint: Pick the main record type. One row in your report = one of these.
